action.content:
WITH office_reviewers AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT f.uid
  FROM fdbk_g1 f
  JOIN items_g1 i ON f.ref_id = i.ref_id
  WHERE i.main_cat = 'Office Products'
),
reviewer_cats AS (
  SELECT f.uid, COUNT(DISTINCT i.main_cat) as cat_count
  FROM fdbk_g1 f
  JOIN items_g1 i ON f.ref_id = i.ref_id
  WHERE f.uid IN (SELECT uid FROM office_reviewers)
  GROUP BY f.uid
)
SELECT 
  COUNT(CASE WHEN cat_count >= 2 THEN 1 END) * 100.0 / COUNT(*) as pct
FROM reviewer_cats;
